items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: But some people will try to take credit for it... Jay and Ray in Switzerland and all that shit, but I heard it.

ctx.x: caviar and I think I'll try the wine of the region. I never do these things, see, because I don't drink anyway. So just give me very simple food and a nice, clean room with a shower and bath because I'm finishing up my book, you know what I mean, and then I can...I'm happy. But I don't know... I really don't know what to say as far as what... if I've made a contribution musically. That, history will have to determine, and usually they don't decide whether you've done anything until after you're dead and gone.…

I heard it. So nobody can tell me any different. See, I heard it. I heard it in 1916, '17, '18 and on until, you know, and I could still hear "The Penitentiary Blues" and those things that he did. But some people will try to take credit for it... Jay and Ray in Switzerland and all that shit, but I heard it. And until somebody proves different, that's how it is.

But I have never been so inspired as a pianist as I have been by Art Tatum. I've been influenced by him. And I don't play anything like him. The only thing Art Tatum taught me was to get a tone out of the piano.
